# CEN at MJBizCon: Cannabis Industry Luminaries Share What They're Excited for at the Show


We talked with the crowd at the Tech Jam Tuesday night.


[David Mantey, Editor-in-Chief, CEN](https://www.cannabisequipmentnews.com/home/contact/21031431/david-mantey)


[Eric Sorensen](https://www.cannabisequipmentnews.com/home/contact/22879687/eric-sorensen)


[Unit 202 Productions](https://www.cannabisequipmentnews.com/home/contact/21119515/unit-202-productions)


Dec 4, 2024


MJBizCon 2024 kicked off Tuesday evening at the Tech Jam, an event hosted by Green Lane Communications, Sorting Robotics, RollPros, LeafyPack and more.


Cannabis Equipment News was on-site to talk with cannabis luminaries about their expectations for this year's show.
